notes.title: 0.3.9 Available
notes.content:
- Reworked mission 3 (Wetto Run).
- New block added: Radar. It will detect and warn you of nearby entities.
- Recharger block now can store extra energy. Keep draining to enter Supercharge mode.
- Added key binding and an option to invert mouse Y.
- Improved AI for many situations.
- Other small fixes and improvements.

Feedback wanted! Tell us what you think.
